title: Let contentment prove your discipline
summary: Japji turns the visible signs of renunciation inward, into contentment, humility, meditation, mortality, purity, and trust. Let the mind wear the discipline before the body displays it.
takeaway: Let the mind wear the discipline before the body displays it.
lifeApplication: Before reaching for a visible sign of seriousness, choose the hidden one: contentment in the ear, humility in the bowl, and one steady remembrance when the mind wants applause.
